column1: # note: Form 1 line 28b, the 4% surtax: the instructions say it applies to a resident's annual taxable income exceeding $1,083,150. The threshold is the same for every filing status.
# note: Only 5.0% income is probed, so taxable income here is line 21; the 8.5%, 12% and long-term gain income the surtax also counts are not covered.
# note: Line 28b is entered in whole dollars.
# note: Hand-transcribed from the PDF and checked against its text twice.
